about: The post formats the X planner (tools/x_plan.mjs) rotates and the library renderer (tools/library.mjs) exports. Sizes are device pixels. Each format names the canon kind it accepts, how it is cut, the preflight kind and anchor, the X-engine designFormat it hands off as (system/x/x-handoff.schema.json), and its series stage. Built on system/variety/x-post-formats.json (the 29-account benchmark) and the post canon (knowledge/founder/canon/post-component.md: equal left/top insets, bleed right and bottom, no bottom margin; 3 strips + one full image from the cprodb verdict).

rules.insetsEqual: a crop's canvas insets are equal on its anchored corner (+-2px); the window bleeds off the other two edges by >= 5% (founder, cadence-xpost r1)
rules.cutAtGutter: every crop edge falls in a gutter: no text line, chip, avatar or button cut (designers-eye DE-02, DE-07); tools/library.mjs snaps crop edges to the nearest gutter
rules.feedCheck: look at every media item at X's 514px feed tile before planning it (XP-28)
rules.noTextInMedia: no headline text added to the media; the caption carries the words (XP-12)
rules.exportNote: single stills export at 3840 px wide (XS-12); everything >= 2000 px on the long side (XP-11)

formats.title: hero section, one still
formats.feed: single landscape at native 16:10, full width 514x321
formats.crop: the whole 1440x900 fold; the fold already ends on a progressive blur or a deliberate cut (fold.end)
formats.note: the hero renders at its own frame (h4a: 1440x1035 at 2x = 2880x2070, 1.39); 16:10 is the default fold

formats.title: hero load-in, video
formats.feed: 16:10 video, poster frame = the settled hero (XP-03)
formats.crop: the fold; first frame is the money frame
formats.phase2: the X engine needs object storage for MP4 before it can post this (knowledge/x/x-engine-audit.md 4.6)
formats.note: the hero renders at its own frame (h4a: 1440x1035 at 2x = 2880x2070, 1.39); 16:10 is the default fold

formats.title: one region of a product view, close
formats.ratio: 5:6 portrait (the tallest X shows uncut, XP-07) or 1:1
formats.crop: the window's anchored corner with equal canvas insets on its two edges (40-56px at 1x); the window bleeds off the other two; every edge snapped to a gutter. 2-3x the scale of the full shot in the feed

formats.title: the whole product view on its canvas
formats.crop: equal canvas margin on all four sides (56px at 1x on cprodb)

formats.title: the full view cut into thirds, a swipeable carousel
formats.ratio: one third of the full canvas each (464x932 at 2.7587x = 1280x2571)
formats.feed: 3-up: strip 1 shows as a 7:8 tile (its middle 56%), strips 2-3 as 16:9 tiles (their middle 28%); the lightbox shows each whole. Lead with the strongest strip
formats.crop: equal thirds of the full canvas; seams fall in gutters where they can (post.seams WARN)

formats.title: the full view first, then its three strips
formats.feed: 4-up: four 16:9 tiles (the full shows almost whole, strips show their middle band)

formats.title: a bento or feature section, one still
formats.crop: the whole section with its own margins

formats.title: one bento cell, close
formats.crop: the cell with equal page margin on all four sides

formats.title: another section alone: pricing, FAQ, footer, testimonials, changelog, CTA
formats.crop: the section with its own margins; never a tall full page (XP-23)

formats.title: one component mid-interaction (post canon)
formats.crop: the component at ~1.5x in its tray, 50-70% of the frame, on #fbfbfb (post-component canon)

formats.title: one component doing its one job, video
formats.feed: square video, poster = the finished state
formats.phase2: MP4 hand-off needs the X engine's phase 2

formats.title: light and dark (or two states) side by side
formats.crop: the subject centred in each tile with >= 8% margin (XP-04, XP-24)

formats.title: four sections of one site
formats.feed: 2x2 grid of 16:9 tiles, centre-cropped; crop each to its moment (XP-06)
formats.crop: four 1200x675 section crops sharing one canvas tone
